public_rationale: The report of high bond yields is evidence of concern about repayment, not an actual repayment outcome. The company disclosure describes contractual terms rather than final payment. No decisive event meeting the early-resolution rule was established by October 28.
limitations: A financing announcement does not establish continued payment compliance.
The forecast has no deadline and does not identify particular obligations.
The unknown accounting basis also prevents a definitive money-claim score.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: CoreWeave will not repay its debts.

statement.excerpt: I do not think CoreWeave makes good on its debts.

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that CoreWeave will fail to honor material debt obligations, not merely that its bonds will fall in price.
Use debts outstanding at publication as the initial population; the statement does not specify how future borrowing should be treated.
Ordinary refinancing that pays existing creditors, and conversion permitted by the original terms, count as honoring an obligation.
A distressed restructuring imposing creditor losses can establish failure. A routine amendment, technical breach or temporary payment delay cannot by itself establish eventual nonpayment.
criteria.support_condition: An authoritative record establishes a material debt obligation ending in nonpayment or a distressed settlement that impairs creditors' contractual claims.
criteria.contradiction_condition: All debts in the defined publication-date population are fully paid or satisfied under their original contractual terms.
